tagline: Hemithea Regatta 2027 — the classic autumn regatta of the Marmaris yacht club: an offshore passage to Orhaniye and a series of races in Hisarönü Bay. Seven nights on board, a steady autumn breeze and two professional racers in the crew.

included: Charter of a racing yacht for the whole period: training, the offshore passage, the bay races and the passage back
Accommodation on board for all 7 nights — a berth in a cabin
Two professional sailors throughout the regatta
Theory, briefings, race debriefs and practice on the water
Organisational support and crew coordination ashore
extras: Flights to Turkey and back — Dalaman or Bodrum airport
A hotel for the night before the start (28–29 October) and after the finish (5 November) — we will help you book it
Meals ashore, personal expenses and personal gear
The berth at Martı Marina in Orhaniye, if it is not covered by the entry fee — we are checking with the organisers

conditions.label: Lodging
conditions.text: We live on the yacht for all 7 nights: in the marinas of Marmaris and Orhaniye and at anchor in the coves of the bay. Cabins, a shared galley, a limited supply of fresh water. Bring a soft bag rather than a suitcase — we will send a full packing list in advance

harbor.note: Regatta port — Marmaris, Turkey. Hemithea Regatta, 29 October – 5 November 2027. Arrival on Friday–Saturday, flights home on Saturday, 6 November.

itinerary.title: The Hemithea Regatta week, day by day

summary.title: From Marmaris to Hisarönü Bay and back

itinerary.intro: One of the most respected autumn regattas of the Turkish Riviera, run for many years by the Marmaris International Yacht Club (MIYC). Two formats in one week: a long sea passage and tactical races in a sheltered bay. In autumn the wind here is steady and predictable, the days are +22…+25 °C, the sea is still warm, the marinas and coves are empty, and experienced crews from all over Europe come to the start. Watches, sail handling, navigation and the galley — everyone in the crew has a place.

days.label: 29–30 Oct, Fri–Sat
days.title: Arrival day
days.text: We arrive in Marmaris. We take over the yacht, register at the MIYC office, meet the crew and share out the cabins. A training sail.

days.label: 31 Oct, Sun
days.title: Preparation and opening
days.text: Skippers’ briefing and the official practice race. In the evening — the opening ceremony of the regatta in Marmaris.

days.label: 1 Nov, Mon
days.title: Offshore race: Marmaris → Orhaniye
days.text: A long passage along the coast — the first real test for the crew. The night is spent at Martı Marina in Orhaniye.

days.label: 2–4 Nov, Tue–Thu
days.title: Race series in Hisarönü Bay
days.text: Passage races and short coastal races in one of the most beautiful bays in Turkey. A prize-giving every evening, nights at anchor in the coves of the bay.

days.label: 5 Nov, Fri
days.title: Final and gala dinner
days.text: The fleet sails back from Orhaniye to Marmaris. The closing ceremony of the regatta and the team gala dinner.

days.label: 6 Nov, Sat
days.title: Flights home
days.text: We head home — or stay on to relax in Marmaris, we will help arrange it.

itinerary.note: No experience is required: before the start there are briefings, theory and training sails, and roles on board are assigned to match your ability. The entry, the paperwork, preparing the yacht and dealing with the organisers are all on us.
